entities.name: Tracking Area Updating Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for updating UE tracking area information with the network.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to complete tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: Low priority indicator
entities.description: IE indicating if UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Timer started when Extended wait time is received from lower layers.

entities.name: Timer T3448
entities.description: Timer started when Extended wait time CP data is received in NB-S1 mode.

entities.name: Timer T3411
entities.description: Timer controlling periodic tracking area updating.

entities.name: Timer T3402
entities.description: Timer started when tracking area updating attempt counter reaches 5.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE
entities.description: EMM state when UE is attempting to update tracking area.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: EMM state when UE is registered with normal service.

entities.name: Access barred condition
entities.description: Condition when access is barred due to access class barring, EAB, ACDC or NAS signalling connection rejection.

entities.name: Extended wait time condition
entities.description: Condition when Extended wait time is received from lower layers.

entities.name: EPS update status EU2 NOT UPDATED
entities.description: EPS update status set to NOT UPDATED when tracking area updating fails.

relations.description: Tracking area updating procedure involves sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
Tracking area updating procedure involves sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message may contain low priority indicator IE.
Extended wait time condition starts timer T3346.
Access barred condition prevents starting tracking area updating procedure.
Tracking area updating procedure requires EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE state in abnormal cases.
Failed tracking area updating procedure establishes EPS update status EU2 NOT UPDATED.
Timer T3411 expiration triggers tracking area updating procedure.
Timer T3402 requires EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE state when started.
Timer T3448 running prevents starting tracking area updating procedure with signalling active flag.
